# Governance

## Steering circle

The steering circle should record durable decisions in public meeting notes, but private resident contact details must stay out of the shared documentation folder.

## Voting policy

A proposal is accepted when at least three active coordinators approve it and no safety concern remains unresolved.

## Record keeping

Meeting summaries should link to the season, orchard site, and affected workstream. Temporary scheduling chatter should not become permanent guidance.
